description: Internal, persistence only (never part of the REST API): the fields of a Submission that have no column of their own in DATA_ACCESS_SUBMISSION and are not stored in DATA_ACCESS_SUBMISSION_STATUS or DATA_ACCESS_SUBMISSION_ACCESSOR_CHANGES, stored as its SUBMISSION_JSON document.

researchProjectSnapshot.description: The snapshot of the research project associated with the submission.

isRenewalSubmission.description: True if the submission is a renewal submission.

publication.description: Link(s) to publication that used the controlled data.

summaryOfUse.description: Summary of how the data has been used.

subjectId.description: The ID of the subject user interested in.

subjectType.description: The type of the subject user interested in.

schemaData.description: Additional data provided by the submitter, validated against the JSON Schema referenced by the AR version recorded on the submission.
